title: Give all twelve historical studies an exact source disposition
summary: Each of the 12 historical slugs now has one record with publisher/DOI and version, local source files (paths, sizes, SHA-256), official AddBiomechanics 1.0 archive members (metadata only), legacy artifact and converter candidate, discrepancies, unknowns, disposition, linked tasks and next bounded action. UM24K: local S1/S2 MAT files are byte-identical to Dryad version 6 (source_available_reconcilable, owned by UM24K-F01). The other eleven derive from AddBiomechanics: no B3D source found in the searched folders, legacy Parquet not local and not traceable to source bytes; official archive members are identified (both model variants: 346.7 GB compressed; ca23 alone 244.9 GB). Five of them (ca23, mo15, ti19, vz22, wa23) also have openly licensed original publisher data (78.4 GB together; ca23 28.9 GB). Rebuild scope and source route are put to José as D-HIST-01-1. All twelve legacy artifacts stay archive_legacy_unbound. The AddBiomechanics ledger's 12 studies are not the 12 pages: they include sa17 (no page; out of scope, untouched) and exclude um24k.

decisions.question: Eleven historical studies came from AddBiomechanics. Their source files were not found in the searched folders, and the old LocoHub files cannot be traced to any source file. Five also have openly licensed original data from the publishers. From which source, if any, should LocoHub rebuild them?

options.label: Archive all eleven
options.consequence: Pages stay labelled legacy with corrected citations; no download; AddBiomechanics tasks pause. Reversible.

options.label: Publisher originals where open, AddBiomechanics otherwise
options.consequence: Originals for Carter, Moore, Lencioni, van der Zee and Wang, AddBiomechanics for the other six: about 108 GB; needs five new original-format adapters plus the AddBiomechanics one. Reversible.

options.label: AddBiomechanics for all eleven
options.consequence: About 347 GB with one adapter; Carter alone is 245 GB, more than the 164 GB free; reprocessed derivatives only. Reversible.

decisions.options_order: By total data to download: none, about 108 GB, about 347 GB.
decisions.cost_of_waiting: Historical pages stay labelled legacy and unreviewed; AddBiomechanics tasks stay blocked; no active dataset is affected.
decisions.why: The publisher originals are the primary records for five studies and cut the total download from about 347 to about 108 GB (Carter from 245 to 29 GB). The cost is five new source adapters, each piloted one study at a time.
decisions.check: Decision sheet figure: Carter's blue AddBiomechanics bar (245 GB) crosses the free-disk line, while its orange publisher bar (29 GB) does not.
